title: France blames Iran for ‘unprecedented’ supermarket fridge cyberattack | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

France’s Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has blamed Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forlast month’s supermarket fridge cyberattackwhich spoiled fresh produce at around 700 retailers.

“This was an attack of unprecedented scale and unprecedented aggressiveness,” Barrot told reporters Monday, describing it as the first large-scale cyberattack carried out for sabotage purposes on French national territory.

“It represents a major assault on the nation’s interests and on the security of the French people,” Barrot said, adding that France intends to impose retaliatory sanctions “at a European level” and has summoned the country’s ambassador.

There was no immediate comment from Tehran on the French allegations.

This is a developing story and will be updated.
